notes: Extensive testing of multiple entry signals on 5m SOL/USDT (180d, mostly bearish). All tested approaches (stoch cluster, stoch bounce, momentum pullback, EMA cross+ADX, RSI mean-reversion) produce ~30% win rate and PF 0.13-0.34 even with regime gating (2400-bar SMA). Root cause: 5m intrabar noise exceeds signal predictiveness for these indicators. Next steps: (1) test on 15m/1h timeframe for better signal quality, (2) try volume-profile / order-flow based entries, (3) consider multi-timeframe confirmation (1h trend + 5m entry).
